recommendedPlans.title: Recipe authoring consolidation and durable helper
details: Move all five parity declarations without changing titles. Reuse one beforeAll/afterAll alpha/beta/gamma project and cleanRecipe base.
Keep Core host/in-process path-label parity AND actual wrapper/direct-Core equality; they cover different boundaries.
Extract three repeated fresh-process verifier blocks into a private helper, preserving single/shared/cross-harvest topology tests and assert-only vs assert+consume behavior.

recommendedPlans.title: Provider facade and transport protocol suites
details: Provider facade suite retains 16 declarations; wire transport suite retains 23.
Common fetch fixture captures URL/body/headers and returns caller-supplied vendor response. It introduces no hooks. Existing describe-local unstub hooks remain.
Keep malformed response, stream/body-drop, cancellation, timeout, V4 tool choice/reasoning compatibility, Anthropic block/header and Gemini schema/signature assertions.
